errors.text_span: Най-големият сектор е оранжев, с етикет „Съгласен съм“
errors.evidence: The largest sector (52.4%), labeled "Съгласен съм", is red, not orange.
The fourth sector, corresponding to "Не съм сигурен", is orange, not yellow.

The description fails to mention that the green sector ("Не съм съгласен") also has a percentage label (9.5%) displayed on it. It incorrectly implies that only the two largest sectors have percentage labels.
While the legend lists five categories, the chart itself only has four visible sectors, as one category ("Изобщо не съм съгласен") has a value of 0% and does not form a slice.
